english.meaning: to spread apart or move a little off to one side
english.note: 叉開少少 means a little off to the side. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Hey, over there—move aside a little. There’s a roast-meat shop opposite.
exampleSentences.traditional: 喂但係嗰度講，嗱叉開少少，嗰度對面呢有間，誒，燒臘舖嘅。
